newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS puts Gulf Canada ratings under review.
newsitem.headline: CBRS puts Gulf Canada ratings under review.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it placed Gulf Canada Resources Ltd's debt ratings under review following the company's announcement it would launch a C$972-million takeover bid for Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc.
Gulf said it arranged bank credit facilities to finance the deal and would embark on a series of asset sales and debt and equity issues to provide for longer term financing.
CBRS said the acquisition would continue Gulf Canada's drive to expand operations and acquire current production in proven regions with minimal political risk.
It also noted that Gulf had pre-paid its near-term debt maturities and has been paying arrears on preferred shares.
CBRS said it would continue to monitor developments in the takeover bid and re-visit Gulf ratings after meeting with the company and the finalization of the deal.
CBRS's previous ratings for Gulf Canada were:
- B+ (High) for senior debentures and long-term debt;
- B+ (Low) for senior sunbordinated debentures; and
All included a positive outlook. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
